text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ............Outfit, check. Bangs look neat and tidy too...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, is it almost time? Your outing with Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes. She told me that she'd guide me to a place today that could help with training.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It sounds like there will be a lot to learn, so I must stay sharp and focused.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: By the way... hey, Craft. Is there anything off about my appearance? Do I look okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yep, totally perfect! Have lots of fun, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ――! Kris S-san!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I apologize. Have you been waiting long?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...No. ...Just――arrived.
You are――30 minutes early, are you not?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Um, well... I was too excited to wait, so I ended up arriving early.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
That is――......Good to hear.
――...Then, let us go.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Wow...! I didn't know there was an obstacle park for horse girls this close by.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Here, obstacles――are varied――in type.
Diverse movement patterns――can be――practiced.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see. Going through an obstacle course seems like a great way to identify weaknesses.
In that case――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I will focus with full concentration from here on.
So that it connects to my future guidance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ――Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The footing gets narrow ahead.
Kris S-san, please be careful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Thanks.
A rather――challenging――course.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This certainly builds strength.
Both balance and concentration――...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
This section also tests one's sense of balance.
――...Ah!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Cesario! Grab on!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...――Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...! Thank you so much, Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That zip line earlier seemed great too.
Maintaining your posture while gliding looks like a great core workout.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Yes. And――the sensation of cutting through the wind...
――...Exhilarating.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh. In that case, why don't we try it one more time?
I had a lot of fun, too♪

At a cafe on a day off.
I happened to spot Cesario and Symboli Kris S chatting together.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Today's obstacle course was wonderful!
So many ideas for training regimens using obstacles kept coming to mind!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And simply as an activity, it was so much fun!
Maybe I'll invite Craft and the others next time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...You look happy.
...That is what matters.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Truly, today was wonderful!
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (...Huh? When did I end up fully relaxing...?)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Strange... Even though I consciously resolved to stay focused and alert today.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Still, Kris S-san is... really so dependable.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Just being around her puts me at ease somehow...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...No. I was just thinking I'd like to relax like this until curfew.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...Sounds good.
Shall we――order refills?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes, please.
